title: The Coin Minting Combinations
statement:
A royal treasury mints coins of N distinct positive denominations. You are asked to count the number of unique combinations that sum up to Target. The same denomination may be chosen an unlimited number of times.

Two combinations are unique if the frequency of at least one of the chosen numbers is different.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and Target.
Second line: N space-separated integers.
outputFormat: Print the count of unique coin combinations.
